meta.title: Company Lens
meta.description: Source-backed company research: filed SEC disclosures, historical market context and grounded answers, each with the evidence it came from.

footer.boundary: Evidence, not prediction. Nothing here is investment advice.
footer.universe: Universe: a convenience sample of current large caps, not a point-in-time index.
footer.sources: SEC filings and adjusted daily prices
footer.fixtures: Development build: synthetic fixture data, not market data.

home.metaDescription: Search a covered company and read its filed disclosures, historical return and risk, recent events and grounded answers.
home.title: Read the evidence before the opinion.
home.lede: Every number on a company page was computed from filed SEC disclosures and adjusted daily prices, and links back to the document it came from.
home.coverage: {companies} companies have a research snapshot in this build. A symbol outside that set gets a stated boundary, never a generated page.
home.fixtureBannerBody: This build is reading synthetic fixtures generated for testing. Issuers named SYNxxx are not real companies and these are not market prices.

search.label: Search by symbol or company name
search.hint: {count} companies covered. Type a symbol and press Enter.
search.noMatchBody: This build holds evidence only for the companies listed below. Nothing is fetched on demand and no page is generated for a company without a snapshot.
search.ambiguous: {count} companies match. Choose one from the list.

home.featuredNote: Three pages to start from. Not a ranking, a recommendation, or a screen result.
home.evidenceNote: Three sources, each with its own time of observation. The research page states how each one is handled.

filings.title: SEC disclosures
filings.body: 8-K items and recent periodic reports, read from EDGAR with their acceptance timestamps kept.

prices.title: Adjusted daily prices
prices.body: Vendor-adjusted daily closes, used for historical return, volatility and drawdown against a stated benchmark.

fundamentals.title: Filed financial results
fundamentals.body: Figures as filed in Company Facts, with the accounting concept, unit and reporting period they belong to.
